title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slide as Wall Street weighs Iran war impact
title_zh: 今日股市：华尔街权衡伊朗战争影响，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌
summary: Wall Street is assessing the fallout from an expanding conflict in Iran as the US and Israel commit to protracted military action.
summary_zh: 随着美国和以色列承诺采取长期军事行动，华尔街正在评估伊朗冲突不断扩大的影响。

title: US stocks end mixed, trading volatile amid Iran conflict
title_zh: 美股收盘涨跌互现，伊朗冲突导致交易波动
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended narrowly mixed after a volatile session on Monday, with the Dow ticking down marginally, the S&P 500 ending close to flat and the Nasdaq adding just over a third of a percent.Shares dropped early following weekend U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：经过周一的波动，美国股市收盘涨跌互现，道琼斯指数小幅下跌，标准普尔 500 指数收盘接近持平，纳斯达克指数上涨略高于 1/3%。周末后美国股市早盘下跌。

title: Amazon data center unit acquires George Washington University Virginia campus
title_zh: 亚马逊数据中心部门收购乔治华盛顿大学弗吉尼亚校区
summary: Amazon unit Amazon Data Services is acquiring George Washington University's Virginia Science ‌and Technology campus for $427 million, the university said on ‌Monday, part of a rapid expansion of infrastructure to support artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 乔治华盛顿大学周一表示，亚马逊子公司亚马逊数据服务公司将以 4.27 亿美元收购乔治华盛顿大学弗吉尼亚科学与技术校区，这是支持人工智能的基础设施快速扩张的一部分。

title: March seasonality: What to expect from stocks this month
title_zh: 三月季节性：本月股票的预期
summary: Listen and subscribe to Stocks In Translation on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you find your favorite podcast. While US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) saw monthly declines in February — the Nasdaq Composite dropped over 3.5% — what is in store for equities in March?
summary_zh: 在 Apple 播客、Spotify 或任何您能找到您最喜欢的播客的地方收听并订阅《股票翻译》。虽然美国股市（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）在 2 月份出现月度下跌（纳斯达克综合指数下跌超过 3.5%），但 3 月份的股市前景如何？

title: Apple unveils low-cost iPhone 17e with a price tag of $599
title_zh: 苹果推出低价 iPhone 17e，售价 599 美元
summary: Apple (AAPL) has announced a lower-cost iPhone 17e model with a price tag of $599 alongside other new products ahead of the tech company's March 4 launch event.
summary_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 在 3 月 4 日的发布会之前宣布推出一款价格为 599 美元的低成本 iPhone 17e 机型以及其他新产品。

title: Markets react to geopolitical risks, BYD teases 'disruptive tech'
title_zh: 市场对地缘政治风险做出反应，比亚迪嘲笑“颠覆性技术”
summary: Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including how equities (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC), oil prices (CL=F, BZ=F), and US bond yields (^TYX, ^TNX, ^FVX) are reacting to rising geopolitical risk following US airs...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的约翰·海兰 (John Hyland) 在本《市场分钟》中追踪当今走势最强劲的股票和最大的市场故事，包括股票 (^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC)、油价 (CL=F、BZ=F) 和美国债券收益率 (^TYX、^TNX、^FVX) 如何应对美国航空空袭后不断上升的地...

title: Tech stocks today: Nvidia invests $4B in photonics makers, Apple announces low-cost iPhone, OpenAI strikes deal with Pentagon
title_zh: 今日科技股：英伟达向光子制造商投资 40 亿美元，苹果推出低成本 iPhone，OpenAI 与五角大楼达成协议
summary: All eyes are on Nvidia's fourth quarter results, due after the closing bell on Wednesday, as AI concerns continue to grip markets.
summary_zh: 由于人工智能担忧继续困扰市场，所有目光都集中在英伟达将于周三收盘后公布的第四季度业绩。

title: BYD stock jumps on 'disruptive tech'  teaser, despite 41% sales tumble
title_zh: 尽管销量暴跌 41%，比亚迪股价仍因“颠覆性科技”预告而上涨
summary: Chinese EV maker BYD stock jumped on Monday after the company said it would reveal "disruptive technology" at an event later this week. This comes after BYD said global sales tumbled in February.
summary_zh: 中国电动汽车制造商比亚迪股价周一上涨，此前该公司表示将在本周晚些时候的一次活动中展示“颠覆性技术”。此前，比亚迪表示二月份全球销量大幅下滑。

title: The one 'silver lining' of a weakened labor market
title_zh: 劳动力市场疲软的唯一“一线希望”
summary: Piper Sandler chief investment strategist Michael Kantrowitz sits down with Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman to talk about the relationship with equity markets (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) and economic indicators such as inflation, interest rates, and US employment.
summary_zh: Piper Sandler 首席投资策略师 Michael Kantrowitz 与早间简报主持人 Julie Hyman 坐下来讨论与股票市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）以及通胀、利率和美国就业等经济指标的关系。
